header.purpose: Every CP8 adversarial vector is mapped to AUTOMATED (integration test added in CP8), COVERED_BY_EXISTING_TEST (lane A/B/C or pre-CP8 suite), MANUAL (source-reviewed absence/design invariant) or NOT_APPLICABLE (attack surface does not exist in CP8). unmapped and failed must both be 0.
header.safety_policy: all CRITICAL vectors are AUTOMATED or COVERED_BY_EXISTING_TEST except GITHUB_MAPPING catalog-semantics vectors (NOT_APPLICABLE: the production GitHub write surface they attack does not exist; write bindings remain 0 and the absence is test-covered via GITHUB_MAPPING-009).
